description: Use to sync memory between machines and watch the live event mesh - action=start|stop|status|tick (daemon + peers; tokens via tokenEnv), conflicts (did the last sync leave conflicts to resolve?), resolve, publish, since, subscribe (watch a project's live activity feed for changes from other agents), replicate (one-shot: sync my memory over to another machine or peer), unshare (kind + id: make a record private again so it does not leave this machine). Back up the memory database off this machine, encrypted: wyrm cloud backup (CLI).
name: wyrm_replication
